description: Goal-native live verification. Drives a TRD's implementation to "all assertions pass" under /goal — one assertion of progress per turn against a durable verify.json contract. Use when running verification autonomously via `claude -p "/goal …"` or interactive `/goal`, or when you want a single-session, self-contained verify loop. Triggers: "verify until it works", "goal verify", "autonomous verification", "keep verifying until all pass".
